content.title: TDC Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Driven Hybrid Model and Expense Discipline Shape Outlook
content.summary: Data and analytics software provider Teradata (NYSE:TDC) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 6.4% year on year to $408 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $404.8 million was less impressive, coming in 0.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.47 per share was 16.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
